title: Clustered Carbon Nanotubes Damage Endoplasmic Reticulum.
authors: Yadav, Aditya; Fang, Zhou; Wang, Yuxin; Qiu, Kangqiang; Tan, Adrian; Tang, Zihan; Zhang, Xiang; Ji, Baohua; Li, Dechang; Diao, Jiajie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究碳纳米管簇对内质网的损伤机制，虽用分子动力学模拟，但对象为纳米材料-脂膜互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Carbon nanotubes (CNTs) have garnered significant attention in recent years due to their unique properties and their wide-range applicability. However, alongside these promising applications, concerns regarding the potential toxicity of CNTs have emerged. In this context, through this work, we have attempted to explore the nanotoxic effect of CNTs over endoplasmic reticular (ER). Using structure illumination and transmission electron microscopies, we unveiled that during endocytosis processes, CNTs form clusters, which lead to fragmentation of the ER structure by puncturing them, thereby inducing potential nanotoxicity. In addition, RNA sequencing data showed that after incubation with CNTs, activating transcription factor 4 (ATF4), a gene responsible for ER stress, was found to be up-regulated. To explore the molecular mechanism, we employed molecular dynamics and coarse-grained simulations and found that clustering of CNTs can significantly increase the speed of lipid extraction, resulting in severe damage.
abstract_zh: 碳纳米管（CNTs）因其独特的性质及广泛的应用前景，近年来受到了极大关注。然而，在这些有前景的应用之外，关于CNTs潜在毒性的担忧也随之浮现。在此背景下，本研究尝试探讨CNTs对内质网（ER）的纳米毒性效应。利用结构照明显微镜和透射电子显微镜，我们揭示在胞吞过程中，CNTs形成聚集体，通过刺穿ER结构导致其碎片化，从而诱发潜在的纳米毒性。此外，RNA测序数据显示，与CNTs孵育后，负责ER应激的激活转录因子4（ATF4）基因表达上调。为探究分子机制，我们采用分子动力学和粗粒化模拟，发现CNTs的聚集可显著提高脂质提取速度，导致严重损伤。
